The '''X2H-8 Overseer Droid''' was a model of [[Supervisor droid/Legends|supervisor droid]] that saw use during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A number of X2H-8 Overseer Droids oversaw the work of [[S7-H7 Slicing Droid]]s, [[BB-22 Salvage Droid]]s, and [[JT-65 Salvage Droid]]s in the [[Barasin Refuse Yards]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
X2H-8 Overseer Droids appear as enemies in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where they can be found in the Barasin Refuse Yards in the Imperial version of Balmorra.<ref name="TOR" />
